candidates.change_summary: Change return value from `_owner` to a constant non-zero address.
Replace `_transferOwnership(newOwner);` with `_transferOwnership(msg.sender);` so ownership is always transferred to the caller instead of the argument.
Move `_transferOwnership(newOwner);` before the zero-address require check, allowing the owner to be set to address(0).
Remove the zero-address require check, allowing ownership transfer to address(0).
Delete `onlyOwner` modifier so anyone can call `transferOwnership`.
Replace `owner() == _msgSender()` with `true` so `onlyOwner` always passes, letting anyone use protected functions.
Delete the assignment `operator = _operator;` so that operator remains unchanged.
Replace `operator = _operator;` with `operator = address(0);` so operator becomes zero address regardless of argument.
Replace `operator = _operator;` with `operator = owner();` so operator becomes the contract owner.
Delete the `require` statement in `onlyOwner`, removing the ownership check so anyone can call `setOperator`.
Insert `operator = msg.sender;` before the existing assignment so operator is set to caller instead of argument.
Move `onlyOwner` modifier from `setOperator` to `setRewardsRecipient`, leaving `setOperator` without access control.
